The camera pans slightly to show the minimalist exterior under overcast daylight. (2) The scene shifts to a glass display case inside the bakery, showcasing neatly arranged trays of various croissants and pastries. The items include salted butter rolls, chocolate-filled croissants, and savory buns with green onion toppings. Small white price tags with Chinese text are visible next to each item. A person's hand is seen sliding open a glass door to the shop. (3) A smartphone screen is presented, displaying an Instagram profile page for '@casadolcecasa.99' featuring a grid of high-quality food photography. This transitions to a hand holding a white paper shopping bag with the 'CDC BAKERY' logo outdoors. The interior of the bakery is shown, characterized by clean wooden furniture, a curved glass counter, and warm lighting. (4) The camera cuts to the exterior of the '南市立棒球場 MUNICIPAL BASEBALL STADIUM' sign, followed by a medium shot of a man in a green t-shirt sitting in a brightly lit indoor space. He is shown eating various items: pulling apart a soft salted butter roll, biting into a dark green canelé, a flaky chocolate croissant, and eating tiramisu from a cup with a plastic spoon. He looks directly at the camera, nodding and gesturing with a thumbs-up.
